# sq-22 — squalify must state, or own, how text escaping depends on the .NET runtime

Documents the byte-stability guarantee: descriptor bytes are guaranteed identical only within one .NET runtime major version, because JSON string escaping comes from the runtime's encoder. Fingerprints are already runtime-stable (sq-06 projection JSON). Docs only.

**Findings:** sq-02 architect finding 4: JavaScriptEncoder escapes BMP code points the runtime's Unicode tables leave unassigned, so an app hosting the library on a newer .NET can get different bytes from the same squalify version. design.md:310 covers only the CLI (tool.version bump). Owner decision needed: document the guarantee as per runtime major version, or ship an in-repo escape table. · **Size:** S · **Tree:** core

**2026-10-27** — Owner decision (2026-10-27): descriptor bytes are guaranteed only within one .NET runtime major version; document it (consumers pin the package and the runtime). No in-repo escape table. Fingerprints are already runtime-stable (sq-06 ProjectionJson).

trust: unverified; by: Jon Robbins

**2026-10-27** — From sq-26 review (P5): when documenting the per-runtime-major guarantee, add it to the README 'Use as a library' version policy, where library consumers read it.
